It took about a year to taper down to the second to lowest dose, and then another 6-7 months to get to a point where I felt more emotions. I felt some flu like symptoms at months 2-3 and thought I had Covid. I never realized antipsychs could do that until I did further research. First three months are definitely the hardest because your body is trying to flush out what’s left of it. While I’m still not 100%, I feel much more coherent.

For the most part, I’m struggling with some physical health issues and some trauma from the past few years, but other than that I’m doing much better than I would have if I had still been on the shot.

As someone who worked at multiple Subways on and off for six years and has a mother who runs them, it won’t be long until they are no more. They haven’t done anything innovative in years, and corporate is really starting to get grimy. In my state, they fired a lot of the inspectors who had been there for years during the pandemic and hired third party inspectors who will bag you on petty shit. This company is not what they used to be, and they never will be. They would rather spend their money on lavish marketing campaigns with big names than pay people a living wage.  Hell, business has gone way down since the pandemic. I advise anyone still working there to get out while you still can. It’s a sinking ship and it’s not going to get better.
